SASBDB entry SASDV25  (https://www.sasbdb.org/data/SASDV25/)

Publication: A conserved viral RNA fold enables nuclease resistance across kingdoms of life.
DOI:         https://doi.org/10.1093/nar/gkaf840

The publisher's PDF is not kept in this folder; fetch it from the DOI above. The fitting
script test/fitting_tests/SASDV25/ cites what it takes from the SASBDB record.

Files: fit2 only (RNAMasonry model, CRYSOL chi2 0.958). SASBDB fit1 (PyMOL model, chi2
125.7) is deliberately not used. The model is unmodified.

Audit (2026-11-13, round 5): buffer (Tris-HCl, no MgCl2), SEC buffer = SAXS buffer, and the RNAMasonry model of the PKm 0 mM MgCl2 data (chi2 0.96 in the paper) checked against the paper text (Methods p. 5, Results p. 9, Data availability p. 14). Temperature 20 C, wavelength 0.082 nm and 0.0002 % NaN3 are SASBDB-only (paper defers to its Supplementary Table S1, not available).
